title: Operator Systems in Duality
summary: The usual dual of an infinite-dimensional order-unit space need not carry an order unit, and this is the main reason why duality for operator systems is notoriously hard. Rather than trying to compute a canonical dual object, we introduce a relative notion of duality for operator systems: Two systems are in duality when a pairing of their underlying vector spaces induces conic pairings at every matrix level.
